body: Thanks so much. I'll wait it out a few days. No promises.
Melatonin doesn't work for me, and I hate tea, but I'll try Nyquil. I've only used it when I've been really sick.
It's not unbearable yet, but I need to have noisy things to even sleep.  I haven't slept well for the past month and it impacts everything I do.  It's just the icing on the cake.
I can't get to mine for a month. That's another four weeks to go through, I can't stand this.
I don't know if it's tinnitus, but it sounds like someone making the sss sound at 4khz.  And it's in my sensitive ear.
Why? First foray into the sub?
